risk_if_not_implemented: Without DevSecOps, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Uncontrolled Internal Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Engineering Principles
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of industry-recognized security, compliance and resilience practices in the specification, design, development, implementation and modification of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Engineering Principles (SEA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of DevSecOps (TDA-11) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Technology Development & Acquisition
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of tailored development and acquisition strategies, contract tools and procurement methods to meet unique business needs.
compensating_control_2.justification: Technology Development & Acquisition (TDA-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of DevSecOps (TDA-11) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
